top.sql: select "components"."id", "components"."name", "components"."description", "components"."region", "components"."only_show_if_degraded", "components"."uptime_start_date", "components"."note", "components"."group_id", "component_groups"."name" as "group_name", "component_groups"."display_order" as "group_order", "component_groups"."created_at" as "group_created_at", "component_groups"."updated_at" as "group_updated_at", "components"."display_order", "components"."created_at", "components"."updated_at" from "components" left join "component_groups" on "components"."group_id" = "component_groups"."id" where "components"."internal" = ? order by "component_groups"."display_order" asc, "components"."display_order" asc

SELECT v.component_id AS componentId,v.name,v.vendor_name AS vendorName,v.status_page_url AS statusPageUrl,v.mode,v.state,v.unavailable_at AS unavailableAt,v.last_read_at AS lastReadAt FROM vendor_dependencies v JOIN components c ON c.id=v.component_id WHERE c.internal=0 ORDER BY v.created_at,v.id

SELECT DISTINCT trim(component.region) AS region FROM components AS component
        WHERE component.internal = 0 AND length(trim(component.region)) > 0
          AND (component.only_show_if_degraded = 0
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component_standing_claims AS claim
              WHERE claim.component_id = component.id AND claim.state <> 'Operational')
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident_components AS claim
              JOIN incidents AS incident ON incident.id = claim.incident_id
              WHERE claim.component_id = component.id AND claim.state <> 'Operational'
                AND claim.published_at IS NOT NULL AND incident.deleted_at IS NULL AND incident.lifecycle <> 'Resolved')
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_components AS claim
              JOIN maintenance AS window ON window.id = claim.maintenance_id
              WHERE claim.component_id = component.id AND claim.state <> 'Operational' AND window.state = 'In progress'))
